picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's Claude reportedly produced a verified proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, one of mathematics' oldest unsolved problems — a landmark test of AI as a genuine research collaborator rather than just a tool.
picks.title: AI Takes on the Riemann Hypothesis: What Does It Mean for the Future of Mathematics?

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, discussed by Fermilab's director and the Under Secretary for Science at SC26, signals a coordinated national push to fuse AI/superintelligence with HPC across the federal science complex — a major policy and infrastructure bet with long-term funding implications.
picks.title: Genesis Mission assembles Avengers to accelerate American science

picks.editorial_note: A £10M, nearly 700,000-patient trial of AI-assisted mammography across 30 UK sites is the largest of its kind ever run, with direct potential to change breast-cancer screening practice worldwide.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.editorial_note: A $25 million Lilly Endowment gift to build Indiana University's Human + AI Learning Ecosystem is a major philanthropic bet on reshaping AI in higher education at scale.
picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: A $22.95 million NSF-funded supercomputer (Kitsune) arriving at Stony Brook and Buffalo materially expands AI and research-computing capacity for a broad regional user base.
picks.title: Stony Brook University Receives Hardware for NSF-Funded Supercomputer, Kitsune - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: Aalto's coordination of FCAI-X, one of six new national Flagship Programme centers, marks a significant expansion of Finland's state-backed AI research infrastructure and cross-institution collaboration.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A Nature Sustainability study co-authored at UCLA quantifying hyperscale AI data centers' outsized power draw adds hard evidence to the policy debate over AI's energy footprint and grid strain.
picks.title: These U.S. data centers use four times the power used in LA

picks.editorial_note: A three-way field deployment between Vanderbilt, a city transportation department, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory shows AI traffic control moving from research into real municipal infrastructure.
picks.title: Vanderbilt, NDOT, Oak Ridge National Laboratory team up to ease traffic with AI

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's CLARKE disaster-assessment tool earning national recognition and expanding to more emergency responders demonstrates AI delivering measurable real-world impact in crisis response.
picks.title: Texas A&M disaster-response AI gains national recognition, expanded use among emergency responders – Texas A&M Stories
